articles.title: South Korean president to visit India, Vietnam
articles.summary: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung is set to visit India and Vietnam this week. This strategic tour aims to bolster Seoul's bilateral relations, focusing on vital economic cooperation and securing fuel supply coordination. For India, the visit signifies strengthening regional partnerships and economic ties, crucial for both nations' strategic interests and stability in the Indo-Pacific.

articles.title: Russian missiles kill 13 including child in Ukrainian cities; Ukrainian drone attack on Russia's Tuapse port kills two children, says governor
articles.summary: Russia launched a series of overnight missile and drone attacks on Ukraine's capital, Kyiv, and other cities. These assaults tragically killed 13 people, including a 12-year-old child, and injured dozens more, causing extensive damage to buildings. This escalation underscores the ongoing conflict's severe impact on Ukrainian civilians and infrastructure, demanding global attention to the humanitarian crisis.

articles.title: Russian strikes kill 16 across Ukraine in worst attack this year; Ukrainian drone attack on Russia's Tuapse port kills two children, says governor
articles.summary: Russia launched its deadliest attack this year on Ukraine's capital, Kyiv, and other cities using drones and missiles. The overnight strikes resulted in 16 deaths, including a 12-year-old, and numerous injuries. This significant escalation underscores the severe humanitarian impact of the ongoing conflict, vital for SSB aspirants studying global security and current affairs.

articles.title: Tejas Networks flags ‘disappointing’ FY26 as BSNL slowdown, order delays hit revenue
articles.summary: Tata-backed Tejas Networks reported disappointing financial results for FY26. The company attributed this performance primarily to the completion of its initial 4G project for state-owned Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited (BSNL). This significant national telecom infrastructure project's conclusion had a noticeable impact on Tejas Networks' financial standing for the fiscal year.

articles.title: CBSE opens Class 10th 2nd board exam 2026 LOC window today, registration ends on April 22
articles.summary: The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has opened the List of Candidates (LOC) submission window for the Class 10 second board examination 2026, effective April 16. This administrative process requires schools to submit student details, ensuring timely registration for the upcoming secondary examinations. It's a critical step for the smooth conduct of the 2026 board exams, impacting numerous students nationwide.

articles.title: Australia to boost defense spending to 3% of GDP, citing growing threats
articles.summary: Australia announced plans to significantly increase its defence spending to 3.0 percent of its GDP by 2033. This commitment comes amidst rising global armed conflicts and follows pressure from the U.S. government. The move aims to enhance Australia's military capabilities and strengthen regional security, reflecting a strategic response to a volatile international landscape and allied expectations for greater burden-sharing.
